title: Soccer Card Watch: The GOAT Debate - Messi vs. Ronaldo
summary: We're here to help you settle the Messi vs. Ronaldo debate. Who's the GOAT?
body_markdown:
This summer, only one opponent stood between[Lionel Messi,](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Lionel%20Messi&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low)[Cristiano Ronaldo](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Cristiano%20Ronaldo&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , and the[FIFA World Cup](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=FIFA%20World%20Cup&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) trophy: Spain. La Roja beat both Argentina in the final a little less than weeks after defeating Portugal on a 91st-minute goal in the round of 16. Two of the greatest careers in the sport’s history—and in the history of sports—both ending their World Cup runs against the same opponent, in the same summer…and as is always the case with Messi and Ronaldo, it added more fuel to the never-ending debate: Who is the GOAT[soccer](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=soccer) player?


Look, we get it. Some of you are supporting Messi, and some of you are riding with Ronaldo. Thankfully, we’re not here to pick a side when it comes to La Pulga and CR7. Both have spent more than two decades trading trophies and records, one built from Barcelona’s famed La Masia academy, the other a seemingly self-made marvel who used sheer will to turn himself into a goalscoring machine at five different clubs. That’s why we owe it to you not to deliver yet another hot take.


Instead, we thought we’d go with the facts—and let you decide.


## **The Trophy Case:**


- **Ballon d’Or:**


- Messi: 8 —the most anyone has ever won
- Ronaldo: 5


- **Champions League Titles:**


- Ronaldo: 5
- Messi: 4


- **League Titles:**


- Messi: 10 La Liga, 2 Ligue 1
- Ronaldo: 3[Premier League](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Premier%20League&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , 2[La Liga,](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=La%20Liga&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) 2[Serie A](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Serie%20A&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BrefinementList%5D%5Bmetadata.Category%5D%5B0%5D=Soccer) , 1 Saudi Pro League


- **World Cup Titles:**


- Messi: 1 — 2022
- Ronaldo: 0


- **More Goals and Trophies:**


- Messi: Copa América wins in 2021 and 2024, along with a[MLS](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=MLS&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) Cup win in 2025
- Ronaldo: 950 career goals, the most in the history of men’s soccer


Neither soccer legend needs our help making their case. You can’t go wrong when it comes to these two. That said, we know you guys have your favorites.


Here’s the more popular player, according to Courtyard’s data.


## **Marketplace Sales:**


Our marketplace has 0% fees. Yes, you read that right: zero fees! That’s why you see plenty of chase cards trade hands between buyers and sellers there—and why one Messi fan paid $3,600 for a PSA 10 2018 Panini Prizm World Cup Blue Prizm Messi card.


How does Ronaldo stack up? His top marketplace sale went for a tad less: A PSA 10 2023 Topps UEFA Club Competitions “Momentos Iconicos” that traded hands for $1,200 back in July.


## **Hidden In Packs:**


For those that want to chase their Messi and Ronaldo cards, there are plenty of heavy-hitters sitting in Courtyard packs as we speak.


The highest value card featuring either of the two superstars is a 2022 Panini national Treasures Road to the World Cup autograph (BGS 9) with a fair market value of $12,256. Find it in our[Wildcard Diamond Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/wildcard-diamond-pack) . Ronaldo isn’t far off though, with a 2002 Panini Sports Mega Craques rookie (BGS 7.5) stashed in the[Sports Cosmic Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/sports-cosmic-pack) that’s worth $11,090.


## **What Fans are Searching for on Courtyard:**


We know about the trophies, we know about the sales, and we know about the gems—now let’s find out what you guys are looking for.


If the search bar on Courtyard had a vote, this one wouldn’t be close: Messi leads every soccer player on Courtyard by a long shot, with more than 37,000 searches. Ronaldo comes in second with more than 24,000, while Manchester City’s[Erling Haaland](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Erling%20haaland&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) comes in third with 6,000+,[Kylian Mbappé](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Kylian%20Mbappe&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) comes in fourth with just over 5,000, and[Neymar Jr.](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Neymar%20Jr&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) comes in fifth with just under 4,000.


## **The Verdict:**


Nope! You can’t trick us into that one. Look, we gave you the stats; we’re letting the data decide. Whichever player you pick, there are plenty of Messi and Ronaldo cards to choose from on Courtyard.
